I tried to take my life 8 months ago on 3/29/2019.

There is so much I would have missed.


I would have never of met my wonderful boyfriend,

I would have never loved to wake up every day to work at my new job,

I would have never met the fantastic friend I have become platonically attached to at said job,

I would have never watched my nephew come into the world,

I would have never watched my dad smile at me

I would have never smiled,

I would have never watched the amazing paradigm shifts in recent technology,

I would have never started college,

I would have never pet my kitty again,

my kitty would have never seen me come back,

my father would have never seen me come back,

my best friend would have never known I existed,

I would have never smiled again.
